label: About
title: About An Opening in the Rhythm
short_blurb: A daily generated front page where the image is the interface.
body: Daily Frontpage is a daily generated interactive front page. Each edition starts from recent saved signals and source research, becomes a new image-led scene, and stays explorable in the archive. The image is the interface: visible marks, objects, and surfaces in the scene open the real sources that shaped the day.

This iteration began with 12 recent saved-signal files and 1 captured links, then narrowed the page to 1 source windows around @mewfeuille: Was recently made aware of an incredible collection of Japanese experimental gig.... A source image from pbs.twimg.com helped set the palette, contrast, edge behavior, and gesture. The scene became An Opening in the Rhythm: Landscape black-ink print on off-white paper. A dominant masked-face fragment with pale crown, sharp eyes and marked cloth merges with a tapered nested-contour island; a smaller elastic-letter mass overlaps fine map traces across open paper. After the image was made, a plate-reading pass mapped 1 visible regions and the mask audit tightened them against Pale crown, outlined eyes, and marked cloth mask within a dark printed field, Nested ink contours flowing from the portrait into a narrow lower-right tip, and Visibly grainy cream paper beneath worn black ink.

typography.rationale: Fraunces and Newsreader fit image-led art objects while Space Grotesk keeps process labels crisp.
